text:
Dr. Elvira Sterinberg
Gynecologist
123 church steet 
Richmond 3212

02-02-2007

Dear Dr. Sterinberg,
RE: Mrs. Larissa Zaneeta
Thank you for seeing Mrs Zaneeta whose features are suggestive of secondary infertility.
Mrs Zaneeta is a 38- year-old marketing manker. She is married and has only a 4-year-old boy.
On 11/07/2005, she presented with stress related anexity and sleeping disorder. She was on oral contraceptive pills then stopped contraception in April 2006. Four months following cessation of contraception, she returned with the same symptoms in addition to failure to conceive. The patient was reassured. In addition, the topics related to conception were discussed including nature of conception and frequency of sexual intercourse.
On 18-01-2007, Mrs Zaneeta presented in a frustrated and anxious mood. Valium was prescribed to help her for sleeping. 2 weeks later, she returned with her husband who was willing to have another child. He did not have any sexual related problems. Moreover, his sperm count was normal.
In view of the above, I would appreciate it if you could provide an assessment of this couple as well as advice regarding management of their complaint.
Should you have any queries, please do not hesitate to contact me.
Yours sincerely,
Doctor
